defaultExpanded.description: If `true`, expands the accordion by default.

id.description: Required. A unique id for each accordion item, also used to derive the ids that link the header and its content for screen readers.

togglePosition.description: Position of the toggle chevron icon.

useDivider.description: Display a divider line between accordion items.

chevronSize.description: Set on AccordionHeader. Size of the toggle chevron icon.

subtitle.description: Set on AccordionHeader. A text that will be displayed as a subtitle beneath the accordion title.
